## Workers compensation insurance
The laws vary in each state and territory.

### State and territory regulators
- Australian Capital Territory: [WorkSafe ACT](https://www.worksafe.act.gov.au/workers-compensation)
- New South Wales: [State Insurance Regulatory Authority](https://www.sira.nsw.gov.au/insurance-coverage/workers-compensation-insurance)
- Northern Territory: [NT WorkSafe](https://worksafe.nt.gov.au/workers-compensation)
- Queensland: [WorkCover Queensland](https://www.worksafe.qld.gov.au/claims-and-insurance/workcover-insurance)
- South Australia: [ReturnToWorkSA](https://www.rtwsa.com/insurance)
- Tasmania: [WorkSafe Tasmania](https://worksafe.tas.gov.au/topics/compensation/workers-compensation)
- Victoria: [WorkSafe Victoria](https://www.worksafe.vic.gov.au/insurance)
- Western Australia: [WorkCover WA](https://www.workcover.wa.gov.au/employers/getting-an-insurance-policy/)

web.description:
# Workers compensation
Workers compensation is governed by individual Australian states and territories.

## What workers compensation is
Employers in each state or territory have to take out workers compensation insurance to cover themselves and their employees.

## Who to contact for workers compensation advice and help
- New South Wales: [State Insurance Regulatory Authority (NSW)](https://www.sira.nsw.gov.au/)
